editingRules.title: JSON as Single Source of Truth
editingRules.description: All content must be managed exclusively through JSON files. No hardcoded data should exist in HTML or JavaScript files.

editingRules.title: Unique Identifiers
editingRules.description: Every book and category must have a unique ID following the format: 'jl-XXX' for books and 'cat-XX' for categories.

editingRules.title: Color Restrictions
editingRules.description: Gold (#D4AF37) is strictly for accent purposes only. Primary color is black (#000000) and secondary is white (#FFFFFF).

editingRules.title: File Structure
editingRules.description: Maintain the established folder structure. All assets should be properly organized in their respective directories.

editingRules.title: No External Dependencies
editingRules.description: The platform runs entirely without a backend. No Firebase, no databases, no server-side processing required.

usageRules.title: Content Attribution
usageRules.description: All resources must include proper attribution to their original authors and publishers.

usageRules.title: Personal Use
usageRules.description: Downloaded materials are intended for personal educational use only. Commercial redistribution is prohibited.

usageRules.title: Respect Copyright
usageRules.description: Users must respect copyright laws and intellectual property rights for all content available on the platform.

usageRules.title: Quality Standards
usageRules.description: Only high-quality, properly formatted resources should be added to the library collection.

usageRules.title: Community Guidelines
usageRules.description: Contribute constructively to the platform. Report any issues or improvements through proper channels.

technicalRules.title: Browser Support
technicalRules.description: Platform supports all modern browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge (latest 2 versions).

technicalRules.title: Accessibility
technicalRules.description: All components must be accessible. Use ARIA labels and support keyboard navigation.

technicalRules.title: Performance
technicalRules.description: Optimize all assets. Images should be compressed, and JavaScript should be modular and efficient.
